class scorpy.BaseVol(nx: int = 10, ny: int = 10, nz: int = 10, xmin: float = 0, ymin: float = 0, zmin: float = 0, xmax: float = 1, ymax: float = 1, zmax: float = 1, xwrap: bool = False, ywrap: bool = False, zwrap: bool = False, comp: bool = False, path=None)[source]

Bases: BaseVolProps, BaseVolPlot, BaseVolSaveLoad, BaseVolProc

A comprehensive representation of an arbitrary 3D volume or spatial function.

Combines metadata management properties, mathematical processing operations, file I/O handlers, and 2D visualization pipelines.

Parameters:

  • nx (int, default 10) – Voxel resolution profile counts matching grid dimensions.

  • ny (int, default 10) – Voxel resolution profile counts matching grid dimensions.

  • nz (int, default 10) – Voxel resolution profile counts matching grid dimensions.

  • xmin (float, default 0) – Minimum physical dimension boundaries tracking baseline configurations.

  • ymin (float, default 0) – Minimum physical dimension boundaries tracking baseline configurations.

  • zmin (float, default 0) – Minimum physical dimension boundaries tracking baseline configurations.

  • xmax (float, default 1) – Maximum physical boundaries tracking grid coordinates.

  • ymax (float, default 1) – Maximum physical boundaries tracking grid coordinates.

  • zmax (float, default 1) – Maximum physical boundaries tracking grid coordinates.

  • xwrap (bool, default False) – Periodic boundary wrapping status conditions indicators.

  • ywrap (bool, default False) – Periodic boundary wrapping status conditions indicators.

  • zwrap (bool, default False) – Periodic boundary wrapping status conditions indicators.

  • comp (bool, default False) – If True, initializes internal data buffers using complex floating numbers.

  • path (str or Path, optional) – Target tracking file destination to load and populating instances immediately.

correction2d(times=True)[source]

Apply (or remove) the 2D solid-angle correction factor to the volume.

Multiplies (or divides) self.vol by sin(psi) * q1 * q2 at every voxel, computed from a meshgrid of the q and psi sample points.

Parameters:

times (bool, optional) – If True, multiply self.vol by the correction factor; if False, divide by it (default True).

Returns:

self.vol is updated in place.

Return type:

None

qq_correction(times=True)[source]

Apply (or remove) the q1*q2 correction factor to the volume.

Multiplies (or divides) self.vol by q1 * q2 at every voxel, computed from a meshgrid of the q sample points.

Parameters:

times (bool, optional) – If True, multiply self.vol by the correction factor; if False, divide by it (default True).

Returns:

self.vol is updated in place.

Return type:

None

rm_selfcorr()[source]

Remove the self-correlation terms from the correlation volume.

Zeros the self.vol entries where q1 == q2 and psi == 0 (or psi == 1 if cos_sample is True) for every q index.

Returns:

self.vol is updated in place.

Return type:

None

class scorpy.IqlmHandler(nq, nl, qmax, qmin=0)[source]

Bases: IqlmHandlerProps, IqlmHandlerPlot

Handler for transforming, evaluating, and plotting data mapped to spherical harmonics.

Parameters:

  • nq (int) – Number of grid points on the q-axis.

  • nl (int) – Maximum degree limit for spherical harmonics.

  • qmax (float) – Maximum bound of the q-axis range.

  • qmin (float, optional) – Minimum bound of the q-axis range. Default is 0.

calc_iqlmp(bl_u, nl=None)[source]

Transform k-space coefficients knlm back into spherical harmonics iqlm.

Parameters:

  • bl_u (numpy.ndarray) – Eigenvectors of the Blqq matrices indexed by [q, q_prime, l].

  • nl (int, optional) – The maximum degree index up to which the calculation is executed. If None, defaults to self.nl.

calc_knlm(bl_u, nl=None)[source]

Transform spherical harmonics iqlm to k-space coefficients knlm via dot product projection.

Parameters:

  • bl_u (numpy.ndarray) – Eigenvectors of the Blqq matrices indexed by [q, q_prime, l].

  • nl (int, optional) – The maximum degree index up to which the calculation is executed. If None, defaults to self.nl.

calc_knlmp(bl_l, nl=None)[source]

Calculate and normalize modified k-space coefficients knlm’.

Parameters:

  • bl_l (numpy.ndarray) – Eigenvalues of the Blqq matrices indexed by [q_ind, l].

  • nl (int, optional) – The maximum degree index up to which the calculation is executed. If None, defaults to self.nl.
